english.text: On January 16, 1919, the 18th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, which prohibited the “manufacture, sale, or transportation of intoxicating liquors for beverage purposes” is ratified. The move came after decades of activism by Americans concerned about the ill effects of alcohol. Prohibition effectively moved the alcohol business into the hands of organized crime, leading to a spike in the crime rate. The 18th Amendment was repealed in 1933.

text: 喺1919年1月16號，美國憲法第18修正案被批准，呢條修正案禁止「製造、銷售或者運輸以飲品為目的嘅醉酒」。 禁酒令有效地將酒精業務轉移到有組織犯罪手中，導致犯罪率飆升。 第十八修正案於1933年被廢除。

english.text: A hundred years after their discovery, the artifacts from Egyptian prehistoric mausoleums will return close to the place where they were found. A huge new museum overlooking the Giza pyramids in Egypt is due to open some of its sections early next year. The exhibit devoted to pharaoh Tutankhamun, known to archeologists as the Golden Boy and in popular culture as King Tut, is expected to draw the most attention.

text: 喺佢哋發現咗一百年之後，埃及史前陵墓嘅文物將會返去佢哋被發現嘅地方附近。埃及有個俯瞰吉薩金字塔嘅巨大新博物館將會喺明年初開放佢嘅部分部分。呢個專為法老圖坦卡蒙而設嘅展覽，畀考古學家稱為金仔，喺大眾文化中被稱為圖坦卡蒙王，預計會引起最多人關注。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the 26th of April of 2025. Before 14:00, a sunny blue-sky afternoon, I went to my neighbourhood's cul-de-sac to meditatively walk around and around there. I admired the gardens. They reminded me of Daoism: how the microcosm reflects the macrocosm: The puffs of sakura would be a nebula afar. One need not really travel too far. Barb my white neighbour was at her driveway. She and her husband Ken would be going out to buy eggs. They eat many eggs.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 4 jyut6 26 hou6。hai2 14 dim2 cin4，jat1 go3 cing4 long5 ge3 laam4 tin1 haa6 zau3，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 ngo5 leon4 geoi1 ge3 siu2 lou6，ming5 soeng2 gam2 hai2 go2 dou6 zau1 wai4 haang4 haa6。ngo5 hou2 jan1 soeng2 di1 faa1 jyun2。keoi5 dei6 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2 dou6 gaau3：mei4 gun1 sai3 gaai3 dim2 joeng2 faan2 jing2 wang4 gun1 sai3 gaai3：jing1 faa1 ge3 ceoi1 hei3 wui5 hai6 jyun5 cyu3 ge3 sing1 wan4。jan4 m4 seoi1 jiu3 zan1 hai6 heoi3 taai3 jyun5。ngo5 go3 baak6 jan4 leon4 geoi1 hai2 keoi5 tiu4 ce1 dou6 dou6。keoi5 tung4 keoi5 lou5 gung1 Ken wui5 ceot1 heoi3 maai5 daan2。keoi5 dei6 sik6 hou2 do1 daan2。
text: 今日係2025年4月26號。喺14點前，一個晴朗嘅藍天下晝，我去咗我鄰居嘅小路，冥想噉喺嗰度周圍行下。我好欣賞啲花園。佢哋令我諗起道教：微觀世界點樣反映宏觀世界：櫻花嘅吹氣會係遠處嘅星雲。人唔需要真係去太遠。我個白人鄰居喺佢條車道度。佢同佢老公 Ken 會出去買蛋。佢哋食好多蛋。
